concepts.title: Clean cartoon suburb
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original wide landscape 2D side-view gameplay environment concept for Supa Dude, a sunny playful suburban superhero runner. Create one finished image, not a collage or asset sheet. No UI, text, logos, lettering or watermark.
Input image: the supplied image is the exact CHARACTER IDENTITY reference, not the background or composition. Preserve its oversized plain white circular head with bold black contour, two small black oval eyes, curved happy smile, very thin BLACK STICK-LINE torso and limbs with rounded ends, and small flowing bright RED CAPE attached at neck. This is a stick figure, NOT a human wearing a costume, NOT a square, NO clothing, shoes, gloves, chest emblem, hair or muscular anatomy. Adapt to side-facing action while retaining visible friendly face. One MC only.
Camera: fixed side elevation, horizon horizontal, sidewalk a clear continuous horizontal gameplay surface, asphalt road one curb lower in foreground, neighborhood houses behind. Show approaching car in side profile nose pointing left toward the rightward-traveling MC; same-plane objects at consistent scale. NOT an isometric, overhead, behind-the-runner, or road-vanishing-point view. Keep one readable gameplay plane.
Shared art direction: richly drawn original suburban neighborhood, BOLD near-black cartoon outlines, thinner interior line details, rounded confident shapes with restrained hand-drawn irregularity. Flat color plus one clean cel shadow, sunlight from upper left, bright blue sky, cheerful warm cream houses, green lawns. Detailed cars and props, simple iconic character. Separate background with lighter outlines, muted contrast and fewer small marks. Recognizable road, sidewalk, lawns, fences, porches, mailboxes, bushes, trashcans, hoops, trampoline, trees where composition allows. Clear obstacle edges, playful harmless comic action. NO ducking, neon night city, geometric spikes, pixel art, 3D rendering, photorealism or muddy painterly shading. Landscape 16:9.

CONCEPT 1 — CRISP SATURDAY-MORNING NEIGHBORHOOD.
Composition: broad side-on street panorama with MC left of center, occupying about 18% of frame height, airborne in a clear jump above the sidewalk. A compact red car is approaching from the right on the slightly lower road, wheels turning. MC's extended line arm sends a small orange fire tongue toward a rounded bush ahead, with a small playful ember puff and clear localized impact. Preserve face, cape and skinny line anatomy.
Environment: welcoming cream and butter-yellow pitched-roof houses, blue shutters, wooden picket fence, tiny flowerbeds, mailbox, basketball hoop in a yard, one blue trampoline farther back, detailed green trash can on sidewalk. Houses have porch posts, windows, roof seams; car has simple glass reflections, door seams, chunky black tires. A few rounded clouds. Keep play space open, props arranged intentionally rather than cluttered.
Rendering emphasis: extremely clean bold ink, smooth rounded contours, fresh saturated sky blue and spring greens, warm cream, restrained lime accents. Flat cel color, very sparse texture, tiny material details. A polished readable cartoon-game screenshot concept, playful with excellent silhouette separation.

CONCEPT 2 — HAND-INKED SUBURBAN COMIC PAGE, richer crafted linework.
Composition: wide side-on view of a cozy residential block, more horizontal breathing space and repeating fence rhythm. MC left of center, about 18% of frame height, in a BRIEF forward airborne superhero boost just above a blue trampoline on the sidewalk: body leaning right, leading line arm extended, line legs trailing and small red cape flowing behind. A curling BLUE WATER blast with white highlights and rounded droplets reaches a green trash can ahead; lid flips harmlessly in a small contained splash. One modest blue station wagon travels toward him from the right on the lower road, drawn in strict side profile.
Environment: coral and warm cream craftsman-style suburban houses with little porches, garages, shingle marks, wooden fences, mailbox, mature rounded trees, garden beds, basketball backboard deeper in a yard. Rich small line details inside simple silhouettes. Sunlit bright blue sky, mint and leaf greens, warm peach cream and coral, black ink, red cape; still SUNNY DAY, no dusk.
Rendering emphasis: slightly organic pen contours, sparse hatching on wood and bark, visible but delicate halftone in selected cel shadows, warm off-white paper character. Comic ink should feel intentional and lively without looking rough or dirty. Background ink lighter than MC and interactive props. Distinctly more hand-printed comic texture than a pristine vector cartoon. Fully colored landscape game concept, not a framed comic panel or page with gutters.

CONCEPT 3 — PUNCHY POP-COMIC SUBURBAN ACTION.
Composition: wide side-on suburban street, energetic but still gameplay-readable. MC around left third, about 20% of frame height, at top of a small jump with bent black line legs and red cape sweeping left. Extended black line arm releases an ANGULAR YELLOW LIGHTNING bolt edged in dark ink toward a red fire hydrant ahead, producing a small jagged pop with tiny harmless fragments. One chunky yellow van approaches from the right in side profile on the lower road, clearly pointed left. The nearest obstacle and car dominate the right half without hiding the sidewalk. There is exactly one hero.
Environment: a bright playful suburb of two-story blue and cream houses, red-brick chimney, crisp driveways, white fences, large rounded trees, a basketball hoop in a yard, small bushes, one trash can, trampoline in garden. Red cape anchors the hero; sky cyan, leafy green, buttery yellow, cream, warm coral. Shadows short and sunlight cheerful.
Rendering emphasis: the boldest graphic silhouettes of the three concepts, expressive slightly exaggerated car proportions, confident black brush outlines, selected Ben-Day dot shadow fills and small geometric motion strokes. Interior architectural and car detail is intentional and lively. Big clear color masses with richer drawing details, no gradients or glossy 3D. Comic excitement without text, full-screen flashes, threatening realism or overwhelming the play route.
